mentions.name: Fotohordr
mentions.description: A photo library browser built with Rust and GPUI, featuring a UI that is reusable across desktop, mobile, and in-browser (WASM) platforms with reasonable performance and quality.
mentions.problem: Existing photo library browsers don't work the way the author wants.
mentions.source_excerpt: working on a photo library browser that works in a way that I want it. Technically, the interesting thing is a UI that is reusable across all of my target platforms (desktop, mobile and in-browser with WASM). Rust+GPUI is the first platform I've seen that makes this possible with a reasonable performance and quality.
